mother of Sophia Jane Harrison

The friendship between the Collinsons and CMY\'s mother\'s family is described by her in Coleridge, [Life](/organisation/40) 31-2; and also in the account she wrote of the novels of Julia (Collinson) Stretton (daughter of Amelia Collinson) in [Women Novelists of Queen Victoria\'s Reign](/book/244).
